name: HoverCard
summary: Rich preview that opens when the pointer rests on a link, and whose content can be reached.

a11y.apg: none: deliberately not the Tooltip pattern. A tooltip is a short LABEL and its content must not be reachable; a preview is content and must be.

props.name: trigger
props.description: REQUIRED. The element the pointer rests on, usually a link or a name.

props.name: children
props.description: The preview. Never put anything essential here: pointer rest is not available to keyboard-only or touch users.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side. The engine flips it when there is no room.
